title: US-open opening-range bracket on 15m: midpoint stop, 2R target, flat by 20:00 UTC, wide ranges only

source.title: The Day Trader skill (trader-scanner, trader-entry, trader-exit, trader-timemachine)

rule_summary: 15m chart, closed bars only, UTC clock, Monday to Friday. Opening range = the two 15m bars opening at 13:30 and 13:45 UTC (the first 30 minutes after the US equity open); RH = their highest high, RL = their lowest low, M = (RH + RL) / 2. The day is armed only if (RH - RL) / RL >= 0.02 (range at least 2%, so the midpoint stop is at least about 1% away and the 0.30% round trip stays under 0.3R). Entry: the first 15m bar opening between 14:00 and 17:45 UTC that CLOSES above RH, bought at the next open; one trade per day per pair. Exits: stop when price trades at or below M (the setup failed); take profit at entry + 2 x (entry - M); time exit: sell at the 20:00 UTC open whatever happens. Day limit: no new entry that day after any exit.
mechanism: The repo's scanner/entry/exit chain trades the first close above the opening range with the stop at the range midpoint, a 1R-2R target and flat by the close. In crypto the US equity open (13:30 UTC) concentrates order flow from US funds, ETF arbitrage and macro releases, so a decisive break of its first 30 minutes tends to continue for hours while late participants chase. The repo's own Time Machine example found a near coin flip on narrow ranges; the 2% minimum range is this lab's answer to its finding that a close stop makes the cost a large share of each trade's risk.
